diagnosis: ClaimWorkspaceShareView uses signing.loads() without a dedicated salt or expiration (max_age) and without binding the recipient email or user ID. Signed tokens generated for other features using default signing (such as email verifications containing workspace_id) can be replayed here. Furthermore, anyone who intercepts a share link intended for a specific external auditor can claim full membership in that private workspace.
